description: Canonical registry of AI agents and models in a corporate governance context for non-exec.ai

entries.name: Claude Enterprise
entries.governance_relevance: Workforce-wide frontier model deployment with enterprise identity, audit, and compliance APIs boards must oversee when AI is embedded in knowledge work.
entries.risk_tier_hint: EU AI Act: likely high-risk when used for employment or credit decisions; general enterprise chat lower tier with human oversight
enterprise_controls: no default training on customer data
board_oversight_hooks: Has management mapped Claude Enterprise to our AI use policy and acceptable-use rules?
Who owns Compliance API monitoring and escalation to audit/risk?
How often do we review Anthropic Risk Reports under RSP v3.0 for vendor risk?
known_limitations: RSP v3.0 shifted from hard capability pause triggers to periodic transparency reports
Boards must actively ingest vendor risk disclosures rather than rely on static procurement checks

entries.name: ChatGPT Enterprise / OpenAI for Business
entries.governance_relevance: Dominant enterprise copilot pattern; boards need visibility into data handling, admin controls, and third-party AI embedded in workflows.
entries.risk_tier_hint: NIST AI RMF: Govern and Map functions; EU AI Act depends on use case (HR, credit, biometrics = high-risk)
enterprise_controls: data not used for training by default (enterprise tier)
board_oversight_hooks: Which business units are approved for ChatGPT Enterprise vs. consumer accounts?
Does our AI governance policy cover custom GPTs and plugin integrations?
What is the reporting cadence on usage anomalies to the audit committee?
known_limitations: Feature set and admin controls evolve frequently; governance docs must be re-verified quarterly
Custom GPTs may bypass central IT review if not governed

entries.name: Microsoft 365 Copilot
entries.governance_relevance: AI embedded in productivity suite affects nearly every employee; board oversight spans data residency, Microsoft Purview controls, and EU AI Act obligations for deployers.
entries.risk_tier_hint: Deployer obligations under EU AI Act for high-risk workplace monitoring; ISO 42001 alignment via Microsoft AI governance materials
board_oversight_hooks: Has management documented which M365 data scopes Copilot may access?
Are Purview policies aligned with our records retention and legal hold requirements?
What KPIs demonstrate responsible rollout vs. shadow AI adoption?
known_limitations: Effectiveness of governance depends on underlying M365 hygiene (identity, DLP, labeling)
Cross-border data flows require explicit architecture review
